Para una empresa, lo que define el resultado es la tasa de aprobación, las cuotas disponibles y la conciliación por transacción para controlar el ingreso neto. Actualizado en 2026 con nuevas plataformas y comparativa de comisiones. Si querés vender online , elegir una de las pasarelas de pago en Argentina es una decisión clave. No se trata solo de “tener un botón de pago”: impacta conversión, comisiones, plazos de acreditación y operación (devoluciones, contracargos y conciliación de liquidaciones). Si además tu operación incluye pagos internacionales , sumá al análisis la conversión, los tiempos de acreditación y la conciliación entre reportes y banco. En esta guía vas a llevarte: una comparativa rápida, un ranking con criterios (no solo “lista”), qué mirar en comisiones y qué cambia según tu negocio: ecommerce, empresas con volumen o SaaS/suscripciones. ¿Qué es una pasarela de pago? Una pasarela de pago es la tecnología que permite procesar pagos online conectando el proceso de pago de un comercio con bancos, redes de tarjetas y otros métodos. Suele encargarse de crear la intención de pago, confirmar el estado de la transacción y facilitar la liquidación y los reportes para conciliar. Tipos de soluciones: pasarela, adquirente y plataforma integrada En Argentina conviene separar tres roles, porque se comparan distinto: Adquirente: procesa principalmente tarjetas y liquida los fondos al comercio, normalmente con un número de comercio propio. Gateway (pasarela): orquesta el pago y devuelve el estado de cada transacción, conectando tu sistema con los adquirentes y métodos. Plataforma integrada: combina la experiencia de pago con la operación (suscripciones, reportes, conciliación) en una sola herramienta. Comparativa rápida de pasarelas de pago en Argentina (2026) La tabla es un punto de partida. Para decidir, pedí el detalle por método de pago y por plazo de acreditación, y validá que el reporte te permita conciliar (orden, transacción, comisiones, neto y liquidaciones). La comparación mezcla adquirentes, gateways, plataformas integradas y soluciones complementarias, porque en la práctica muchas empresas evalúan estas opciones juntas al diseñar su stack de cobro en Argentina. Proveedor Tipo de solución Métodos principales Mejor para Mercado Pago Plataforma integrada Tarjetas y transferencias Ecommerce generalista y comercios con alto volumen local Payway Adquirente Tarjetas Empresas con volumen y acuerdos comerciales Mobbex Gateway (pasarela) Tarjetas y otros medios (según adquirente) Ecommerce que busca flexibilidad y control PayU Pasarela / procesador regional Tarjetas y métodos locales (según oferta) Empresas con operación regional dLocal Plataforma para expansión regional Métodos locales por país Empresas con expansión en LATAM Rebill Plataforma integrada Tarjetas y métodos locales (según integración) SaaS, educación online y negocios digitales Nave Plataforma de cobro Tarjetas Comercios online que buscan operación simple GOcuotas Solución de cuotas Cuotas / tarjetas Negocios donde la financiación es clave Getnet Adquirente / ecosistema Tarjetas Retail y omnicanal, empresas con volumen Fiserv / Clover Ecosistema de cobro Tarjetas (según oferta) Operación comercial con herramientas + pagos Resumen rápido Ecommerce : cuotas + experiencia del proceso de pago + acreditación. Volumen : acuerdos comerciales + costos por método + reportes consistentes. SaaS/suscripciones : reintentos ante rechazos + recuperación de pagos + conciliación por ciclo. Cobro internacional : operación regional o cross-border: cobertura de métodos locales, conciliación y capacidad de operar más de un país. Nota sobre comisiones y disponibilidad Las comisiones, métodos de pago disponibles y tiempos de acreditación pueden variar según volumen procesado, rubro del comercio, adquirente utilizado y condiciones comerciales específicas de cada proveedor. Los rangos mencionados en esta guía son aproximaciones públicas y pueden cambiar con el tiempo, por lo que siempre es recomendable confirmar condiciones actualizadas directamente con cada plataforma. Rangos y referencias revisados en julio de 2026 a partir de información pública disponible y condiciones sujetas a acuerdo comercial. Las 10 principales plataformas y pasarelas de pago en Argentina (2026) La lista incluye diez plataformas relevantes que operan pagos online en Argentina o permiten procesar métodos locales en el país. Este ranking prioriza: cobertura real de cobro online en Argentina, capacidad de operar cuotas, claridad de costos por método y la facilidad para conciliar liquidaciones. Las condiciones varían por rubro, volumen y acuerdo, pero el objetivo es que te quede una comparación con criterio. 1. Mercado Pago En qué se destaca: Suele ser la primera opción que evalúan comercios en Argentina por reconocimiento de marca, rápida implementación y un proceso de pago familiar para el usuario. Mejor para: Ecommerce y comercios que priorizan implementación rápida y una experiencia conocida. Ventajas Experiencia de pago muy reconocida por usuarios en Argentina Onboarding e implementación suelen ser rápidos Herramientas operativas (devoluciones, gestión básica) Limitaciones Las comisiones varían bastante por medio y plazo de acreditación Si tenés volumen, puede quedar corto en control fino de acuerdos/condiciones frente a esquemas más negociados Métodos de pago: tarjetas de crédito y débito, transferencias y otras alternativas según configuración. Integración: Integración por checkout (proceso de pago) y APIs (interfaces de programación) según el producto; confirmaciones de estado mediante notificaciones. Costos / modelo de tarifas: Tarifario público. Conviene comparar por medio (crédito/débito/transferencia) y por plazo de acreditación. Tipo de solución: plataforma de cobro (pasarela + billetera) 2. Payway En qué se destaca: Se evalúa cuando el foco está en tarjetas y en operar con un esquema más “bancario” y negociado. En Argentina aparece mucho en empresas con volumen o necesidades específicas de operación. Mejor para: Empresas con volumen que quieren negociar condiciones y ordenar operación de tarjetas. Ventajas Apto para operaciones con volumen y acuerdos comerciales Encaje frecuente en stacks más corporativos Puede ser conveniente si tu estrategia es optimizar costos por negociación Limitaciones La experiencia e integración dependen mucho del acuerdo y del producto contratado Requiere más definición operativa (plazos, reportes, conciliación) para evitar fricción Métodos de pago: Principalmente tarjetas de crédito y débito (según contrato). Integración: Integraciones y herramientas varían por producto/contrato. Pedí ejemplos de reportes y campos. Costos / modelo de tarifas: Por acuerdo. Comparar comisión por marca, plazo de acreditación y costos operativos. Tipo de solución: pasarela/adquirencia (orientada a empresas) 3. Mobbex En qué se destaca: Alternativa elegida por comercios digitales que buscan una solución de cobro con integración y opciones de operación. Su diferencial suele estar en la flexibilidad para adaptarse a distintos flujos. Mejor para: Ecommerce y negocios online que buscan flexibilidad de integración y operación. Ventajas Flexibilidad para adaptarse a distintos flujos de cobro Suele integrarse bien en ecommerce Permite trabajar con distintos medios según configuración Limitaciones Para comparar, necesitás detalle fino de medios habilitados, plazos y comisiones Si no pedís reportes consistente, la conciliación puede complicarse Métodos de pago: Tarjetas y otros medios según la integración y la configuración. Integración: Integración vía APIs (interfaces de programación) y componentes de checkout (proceso de pago) según el plan. Costos / modelo de tarifas: Variable según medios y condiciones. Pedí el detalle por medio y acreditación. Tipo de solución: pasarela/plataforma de pago 4. PayU En qué se destaca: Proveedor regional que puede servir cuando buscás estandarizar la integración en varios países, manteniendo un flujo similar. En Argentina, la conveniencia depende de la oferta local efectiva. Mejor para: Operación multi-país que prioriza consistencia regional y una integración centralizada. Ventajas Cobertura regional y experiencia operando en varios mercados Puede simplificar si tu operación está en más de un país Limitaciones La cobertura real de métodos en Argentina puede variar Necesitás validar plazos de acreditación y soporte local Métodos de pago: Tarjetas y métodos locales según configuración y disponibilidad. Integración: Integración por APIs (interfaces de programación) y eventos de estado según suite. Costos / modelo de tarifas: Variable (frecuentemente por volumen/riesgo). Confirmar condiciones Argentina. Tipo de solución: pasarela/procesador regional 5. dLocal En qué se destaca: Se usa mucho para cobrar en moneda local en distintos países y resolver operación cobro internacional. En Argentina puede ser parte de una estrategia regional para empresas fuera del país o con estructura multi-país. Mejor para: Empresas internacionales que necesitan cobro local y operación multi-país. Ventajas Fuerte enfoque en cobro local en múltiples países Útil para expansión sin armar una integración distinta por mercado Limitaciones Suele ser una decisión de empresa (no siempre la mejor opción para comercios chicos) Modelo de precios y condiciones típicamente por acuerdo Métodos de pago: Tarjetas y métodos locales según mercado. Integración: APIs (interfaces de programación), eventos y herramientas para operación multi-país. Costos / modelo de tarifas: para empresas/por acuerdo. Tipo de solución: cobro local para cobro internacional (para empresas) 6. Rebill En qué se destaca Rebill está orientada a negocios digitales que necesitan algo más que simplemente procesar pagos. Su enfoque está en combinar cobros únicos y recurrentes con trazabilidad operativa: estados de pago claros, conciliación por transacción y visibilidad del ingreso neto. Mejor para SaaS, membresías, educación online y productos digitales que necesitan combinar pagos únicos y recurrentes. Ventajas Suscripciones y cobros recurrentes nativos, con reintentos automáticos: recuperan alrededor del 52% de los cobros que fallan por saldo insuficiente. Cuotas como palanca real: en Argentina, entre las empresas que las ofrecen, más de un tercio de las ventas se hacen en cuotas, con un ticket promedio cercano a 3x el de un pago único. Conciliación por transacción: ingreso neto, comisiones y liquidación trazables sin trabajo manual. Integración rápida vía API y SDK, más links de pago personalizables con tu marca. Limitaciones Foco en negocios digitales (SaaS, EdTech, travel y asistencia): no apunta a retail presencial ni a POS físico. No suele ser la opción para comercios muy chicos que solo necesitan un botón de pago simple. Tipo de solución Plataforma de cobros orientada a productos digitales y suscripciones. Métodos de pago Tarjetas y métodos locales según configuración del caso de uso y del mercado donde opera la empresa. 7. Nave En qué se destaca: Opción a evaluar como plataforma de cobro para comercios digitales. El valor está en simplificar la operación, pero es clave pedir detalle de medios, cuotas y reportes. Mejor para: Comercios online que buscan una solución integrada y simple de operar. Ventajas Puede simplificar la operación de cobros para un comercio Implementación relativamente directa según caso Limitaciones Hay que validar cobertura real de métodos y cuotas en Argentina Comparar calidad de reportes para conciliación Métodos de pago: Tarjetas y alternativas según configuración. Integración: Checkout e integraciones según el producto. Costos / modelo de tarifas: Variable; confirmar condiciones vigentes y plazos. Tipo de solución: plataforma de cobro 8. GOcuotas En qué se destaca: Su diferencial es la financiación. Tiene sentido cuando las cuotas son una palanca fuerte de conversión. No siempre compite como “pasarela integral” en todos los medios. Mejor para: Negocios donde las cuotas determinan conversión (ticket medio, categorías con financiación). Ventajas Propuesta centrada en cuotas como palanca de venta Puede mejorar conversión cuando el financiamiento es clave Limitaciones No necesariamente cubre todos los medios como una pasarela integral Conviene evaluarla como complemento o estrategia específica de cuotas Métodos de pago: Cuotas / tarjetas según producto. Integración: Integración según canal y tipo de comercio. Costos / modelo de tarifas: Variable según plan. Pedir costo efectivo de financiar (impacto en margen). Tipo de solución: solución especializada en cuotas (complementaria) 9. Getnet En qué se destaca: Se elige cuando el negocio necesita un proveedor con componentes de adquirencia y operación omnicanal. En ecommerce, la evaluación pasa por integración y reportes, no solo por marca. Mejor para: Retail/omnichannel o empresas que buscan un proveedor de adquirencia con herramientas. Ventajas Alternativa relevante en esquemas de adquirencia y omnicanal Puede encajar en operaciones con necesidades de punto de venta + online Limitaciones El alcance exacto online y los reportes dependen de la oferta/contrato Hay que validar conciliación: neto, comisiones y liquidaciones Métodos de pago: Tarjetas y otros medios según contrato. Integración: Integraciones varían por producto. Pedí ejemplos de reportes y eventos. Costos / modelo de tarifas: Por acuerdo. Comparar por marca, plazo y costos operativos. Tipo de solución: adquirencia + ecosistema de cobro (omnichannel) 10. Fiserv / Clover En qué se destaca: Aparecen en el radar cuando el negocio busca un ecosistema más integral de cobro. Para Argentina, la clave es validar disponibilidad local, partners y alcance real (online y/o presencial). Mejor para: Comercios que buscan un ecosistema de cobro más completo (según disponibilidad local). Ventajas Ecosistema integral (según configuración) para operación comercial Puede sumar si necesitás una solución combinada Limitaciones En Argentina, disponibilidad y alcance dependen de partners/oferta local Conviene explicar el encuadre: no es idéntico a una pasarela puramente online Métodos de pago: Tarjetas y otros medios según oferta local. Integración: Herramientas e integraciones según implementación. Costos / modelo de tarifas: Variable por plan/acuerdo; considerar costo total (servicio + equipamiento si aplica). Tipo de solución: ecosistema de cobro (software + hardware) + procesamiento Comisiones de las pasarelas de pago en Argentina Acá conviene ser muy concreto: la comisión depende del medio de pago , el plazo de acreditación , el rubro y el acuerdo. Cuando hay tarifario público, se pueden usar rangos de referencia. Si no, lo correcto es pedir cotización y comparar con la misma canasta de medios. Los valores pueden variar según volumen procesado y acuerdo comercial. Rangos de referencia (Argentina) Como referencia pública, en Argentina las comisiones por transacción suelen moverse en estos órdenes de magnitud, siempre sujetas a rubro, volumen y acuerdo: Tarjetas de crédito: habitualmente entre 3% y 6% + IVA, según plazo de acreditación. Tarjetas de débito: suele ser menor que crédito, con acreditación más corta. Transferencias y QR: normalmente el método más barato (en torno al 1%–2%). Cuotas: sumale el costo financiero, que puede cambiar por completo el neto. Las tarifas públicas de Rebill en Argentina están en su página de precios , y las de cobro cross-border en precios . Cómo comparar comisiones sin engañarte Para comparar de forma útil, pedí el detalle por método y por plazo de acreditación, e incluí en la comparación: devoluciones, contracargos y cómo se reporta el neto liquidado . La comisión “barata” deja de serlo si la conciliación termina en trabajo manual. Cómo funcionan las pasarelas de pago en Argentina Del proceso de pago a la liquidación Inicio del pago : el usuario elige medio (tarjeta, transferencia, cuotas). Procesamiento : se aprueba o se rechaza la transacción. Confirmación : tu sistema recibe el estado para entregar el producto/servicio. Devoluciones/contracargos : pueden aparecer días después y afectan el neto. Liquidación : el dinero se acredita según plazos, a veces agrupado. Conciliación : se cruza orden, transacción, comisiones y liquidación. Qué métodos de pago aceptan las pasarelas de pago en Argentina Métodos principales y cuándo conviene sumarlos Para cobrar online en Argentina, lo normal es comenzar con tarjetas y luego sumar alternativas según conversión y costo. Cada método tiene impacto distinto en aprobación, comisiones y operación. Tarjetas de crédito : clave para conversión y para cuotas. Mirá aprobaciones y contracargos. Tarjetas de débito : útil para audiencias que no usan crédito; la experiencia puede variar. Transferencias : suelen bajar costos, pero requieren buena confirmación de estado. Cuotas : en Argentina son una palanca fuerte; compará condiciones y costo total. Métodos complementarios : si tu público lo necesita, sumá alternativas de cobertura. Pasarelas de pago para SaaS y suscripciones Diferencia entre cobrar una vez y cobrar todos los meses En suscripciones, los rechazos importan más: una caída de aprobación se traduce en churn involuntario. Necesitás reintentos inteligentes, actualización de medios y un flujo de recuperación (recuperación de pagos) que no dependa de trabajo manual. Reintentos, recuperación y trazabilidad por evento Lo importante es poder seguir cada ciclo: intento, aprobación/rechazo, reintento, recuperación, devolución, ajuste y liquidación. Esa trazabilidad reduce discusiones con finanzas y acelera la conciliación por período. Preguntas frecuentes ¿Cuál es la mejor pasarela de pago en Argentina? Depende del tipo de negocio. En ecommerce suele pesar conversión y cuotas; en empresas con volumen, los acuerdos y el control de costos; en SaaS, reintentos, recuperación de pagos y conciliación por ciclo. ¿Cuánto cobran las pasarelas de pago? Varía por medio de pago, plazo de acreditación, rubro y acuerdo comercial. Para comparar, pedí el desglose por método y plazo, y considerá devoluciones y contracargos. ¿Qué pasarela conviene para ecommerce en Argentina? Priorizá cuotas, experiencia del proceso de pago, plazos de acreditación y reportes claros para conciliar liquidaciones. No elijas solo por porcentaje. ¿Qué plataforma usar para cobrar online en Argentina? Elegí según medios, cuotas, integración, soporte y calidad de reportes (identificadores, comisiones, neto y liquidaciones). Otros métodos de cobro complementarios (no son pasarelas) Cuándo tiene sentido sumarlos Redes de cobranza como Pago Fácil o Rapipago pueden servir como alternativa de pago en efectivo, pero no son pasarelas de pago. Si tu audiencia lo necesita, sumalas como método complementario a tu pasarela principal para mejorar cobertura. Cómo elegir una pasarela de pago en Argentina Para elegir bien en Argentina, compará: métodos disponibles (tarjeta, transferencia, cuotas), plazos de acreditación, costo total (comisiones + IVA + cargos), soporte para devoluciones/contracargos y la calidad de los reportes para conciliar liquidaciones. Si tu operación mezcla adquirentes, gateways y plataformas integradas, asegurate de entender qué rol cubre cada proveedor para no duplicar costos ni perder trazabilidad. Checklist general para evaluar una pasarela de pago Antes de comparar proveedores, confirmá qué rol necesitás cubrir: adquirente (tarjetas y liquidación), gateway (orquestación del pago) o plataforma integrada (experiencia + operación). No se eligen con los mismos criterios. Si tu empresa vende productos digitales o trabaja con modelos de suscripción, puede ser útil evaluar plataformas diseñadas específicamente para ese tipo de operación. En esos casos conviene comparar no solo comisiones, sino también visibilidad del ingreso neto, conciliación y herramientas para gestionar pagos recurrentes. Checklist para evaluar opciones Conversión : cuotas, medios locales, experiencia del proceso de pago. Plazos de acreditación : impacto en caja y costos. Operación : devoluciones, contracargos, soporte y tiempos de resolución. Conciliación : reportes con orden/transacción, comisiones, neto y liquidaciones. Integración : documentación, estabilidad, eventos de estado y pruebas. Qué mirar en reportes y conciliación Si el dinero se acredita agrupado, necesitás que el reporte te deje reconstruir el neto por transacción. Pedí campos mínimos: identificador de orden, identificador de transacción, estado, comisiones/cargos, impuestos si aplican, neto y referencia de liquidación. Qué comisiones cobran las pasarelas de pago en Argentina La comisión real depende del medio de pago, el plazo de acreditación y el acuerdo comercial. Cuando un proveedor publica rangos, tomalos como referencia y confirmá siempre condiciones vigentes. Preguntas frecuentes sobre pasarelas de pago ¿Qué es una pasarela de pago? Es la tecnología que conecta tu proceso de pago con bancos, redes de tarjetas y otros métodos, y te devuelve el estado de cada transacción para cobrar online y conciliar. ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre pasarela y adquirente? La pasarela (gateway) orquesta el pago y el estado. El adquirente procesa principalmente tarjetas y liquida fondos al comercio, normalmente con un número de comercio (merchant ID). ¿Qué comisión cobran las pasarelas de pago? Varía por método, plazo de acreditación, rubro y acuerdo. Compará el costo total y cómo se reportan comisiones, impuestos y neto para conciliar sin fricción. ¿Cuál es la mejor pasarela de pago en Argentina? Depende del modelo: ecommerce suele priorizar cuotas y conversión; empresas con volumen, acuerdos y control; suscripciones, reintentos y trazabilidad por transacción y por ciclo. ¿Qué métodos de pago se pueden aceptar en LATAM? Depende del país, pero típicamente tarjetas, transferencias, cuotas y métodos locales. Lo clave es combinar conversión, costos y operación con reportes para conciliación. Conclusión Las pasarelas de pago en Argentina se eligen por conversión, costos y operación. Armá una lista corta, pedí el desglose por método y plazo, y validá que la conciliación sea posible sin trabajo manual (orden, transacción, comisiones, neto y liquidaciones). Si vendés con cuotas, priorizá condiciones y experiencia. Si sos SaaS, la decisión suele definirse por reintentos, recuperación de pagos y trazabilidad por ciclo.

title: Meet AI Agents in Secoda
summary: Learn how Secoda AI Agents transform data governance by turning plain English requests into automated workflows. Automate tagging, lineage, documentation, and dbt models with full transparency and oversight.
body_text: Data teams lose countless hours every week to repetitive governance work like bulk tagging tables, maintaining lineage , writing dbt models, or keeping documentation consistent. These tasks are necessary, but they pull engineers, analysts, and stewards away from high-value analysis and decision-making. With Secoda’s new AI Agents, you can take automation to the next level. Agents combine conversational planning with execution, giving you the ability to request complex workflows in plain English and watch them run with full transparency and oversight. What are AI Agents? AI Agents are scheduled AI chats that automate foundational governance work. Each Agent runs on a daily, weekly, or hourly schedule, uses a defined persona and prompt, creates a new chat for every run, and logs results directly into your workspace. You can review past runs in a dedicated tab and track activity over time. Agents can: Perform internal operations like tagging, metadata updates, and cataloging. Orchestrate external tasks like generating dbt models, creating dashboards, or updating documentation. Execute with configurable personas for different team contexts You can run Agents directly from the Secoda web app or by simply prompting @Secoda in Slack. The experience is the same in both workflows. It’s easy to configure, quick to review, and effortless to execute. Create an agents that runs a usage trends analysis for you on a recurring monthly basis How do AI Agents work? Step 1: Create your Agent Open Secoda AI and select the Agents tab. Start by creating an agent in one of two ways: Custom Agent: Build from scratch with complete flexibility Template: Choose from pre-built templates for common use cases Step 2: Configure your Agent Set up your Agent with: Agent name A clear, descriptive title Persona Choose from your available AI personas Prompt Write the specific task you want automated in plain English Schedule Run hourly, daily, or weekly Tools Enable what the Agent can use in Secoda, such as tagging, glossary creation, documentation updates, or classification scans Start time Pick when the first run should begin Step 3: Schedule and monitor Your Agent runs automatically on the interval you set. View run history and status in the Agents tab, and track activity over time. Each run creates a new chat with the selected persona and prompt for easy review. Step 4: Get results Each Agent run logs results to your workspace and appears as a new conversation. You can access completed runs from the Agent’s run history or from your AI chat history, with full traceability. This keeps you in control while eliminating the hours of repetitive effort. ​​ How Agents work with Secoda AI chats Secoda AI now includes two powerful ways to get work done: chats and Agents. Each is designed for different needs, and together they cover both quick questions and repeatable workflows. AI chats: Use chats when you need fast answers or ad-hoc help. You can ask about a metric, request a query, or get clarity on your data without leaving your workflow. Chats are best for one-time questions and exploration. AI Agents: Use Agents when you want to automate ongoing tasks. Agents can scan your warehouse for PII every week, keep documentation up to date, or generate recurring reports for stakeholders. You give them instructions in plain English, review their plan, and they run the workflow on your behalf. Together, chats help you explore, and Agents help you operationalize. You can start with a simple question in a chat, then turn it into a recurring Agent to ensure the task is handled automatically going forward. Example workflows for data teams AI Agents are designed to take natural language instructions and translate them into concrete actions inside Secoda. That means you don’t need to write code or manually repeat the same steps across your workspace. Here are a few examples of the kinds of tasks you can hand off to an Agent: Metadata updates “Generate descriptions for all tables in the analytics schema.” “Update docs for our most-used tables missing descriptions.” Data discovery & cataloging “Find new tables this month and create catalog entries.” “Discover undocumented sources and suggest owners.” PII & compliance classification “Scan all customer columns for potential PII and apply appropriate classification tags.” “Audit for GDPR compliance and create workflows.” “Mark all customer info tables as Sensitive and notify the privacy team.” Data contracts “Create contracts for new Salesforce data with monitoring.” “Generate contracts for all customer schema tables.” dbt models & documentation “Create dbt models for customer health scores and update lineage.” “Generate staging models for payment data.” Example workflows for business teams AI Agents aren’t just for data team members. They also make it easier for business users to ask questions, explore data, and generate insights without needing to write complex SQL or maintain documentation themselves. Here are some common ways business teams can use Agents: Business metric analysis “Analyze our customer churn rate and identify key contributing factors” “Show me revenue trends across all channels and explain anomalies” “Compare this quarter’s performance to last year with actionable insights” Multi-source data discovery “Find all data sources about enterprise customers and show relationships” “Discover what marketing data we have and how it connects to sales outcomes” “Locate all product usage data and explain how it relates to customer satisfaction” Automated executive reporting “Create our monthly business review with key metrics and trends” “Generate a board presentation showing customer growth and retention” “Build an executive report tracking our North Star metrics” Query & analysis support “Help me analyze customer lifetime value by acquisition channel” “Write a query to calculate MRR growth by segment” “Validate my cohort analysis approach and suggest improvements” Why do Agents matter? AI Agents make it easier to manage the work that typically takes hours of manual effort. They combine intelligent planning, and automated execution into a single, repeatable workflow. For example: A steward can ask an Agent to scan Snowflake tables for PII and automatically tag them for compliance. An analyst can request dbt models with documentation and lineage updates in one step. A manager can schedule Agents to catalog new tables every month so metadata stays current without extra effort. Agents extend the value of existing Secoda features by turning natural language requests into actions. They give every team a reliable way to keep governance consistent as data grows. The future of governance AI Agents shift governance from reactive cleanup to proactive, automated workflows. They reduce manual overhead for data producers, give consumers reliable and compliant answers, and keep visibility and control with your team. AI Agents are a natural next step in modern data governance: proactive, efficient, and designed to scale as your organization grows. Learn more about how to get started with AI Agents .

title: Zepp Health Acquires Core Assets of Wild.AI to Expand Support for Female Athletes Across Life Stages
body_text: MILPITAS, Calif.--Zepp Health (NYSE: ZEPP), the parent company of Amazfit, today announced it has acquired the core assets and intellectual property of Wild.AI , a pioneering women’s wellness platform focused on optimizing female performance through hormone-informed coaching. The acquisition was completed at the end of August and includes Wild.AI’s proprietary technology and select members of its leadership team. ‍ Wild.AI is renowned for using physiological and hormonal data to help women Track, Train, Fuel, and Recover based on their cycle and life stage. From menstruation to menopause, the platform delivers personalized insights that help improve performance, reduce injury risk, and deepen body awareness—serving both elite athletes and everyday fitness enthusiasts. ‍ This acquisition builds on a successful partnership between Zepp Health and Wild.AI, including the recent launch of a Wild.AI mini-app on Amazfit’s Active 2 smartwatch . That collaboration underscored a shared commitment to science-backed, user-centric performance tools. ‍ “Our mantra of Train, Recover, Repeat found natural alignment with Wild.AI’s mission,” said Scott Shepley, Head of Global Marketing, Amazfit. “Rather than reinventing the wheel, we saw an opportunity to make it run smoother and faster—by integrating Wild.AI’s cutting-edge capabilities into our performance ecosystem. This is a major step forward in delivering meaningful value to female athletes across the world.” ‍ “Wild.AI was born from a desire to build for women first—not as an afterthought,” said Hélène Guillaume, Founder of Wild.AI. “Zepp Health shares our belief that physiology-informed tools are critical for women to thrive in sport. Together, we’ll continue to support our community and bring Wild.AI’s science-driven approach to millions more.” ‍ Wild.AI App Key Capabilities: Daily hormone-aware symptom tracking to power individualized insights Integration with wearables (including Amazfit, Garmin, Apple Watch) for enhanced data Adaptive training and nutrition guidance based on hormonal shifts, symptoms, and recovery status Educational content that helps users understand hormonal impacts on performance, recovery, and injury risk Trend analysis and monthly reports that surface correlations between training load, symptoms, and hormonal phases ‍ As Zepp Health expands its offering to better serve the female athlete community, the company will: Continue supporting the existing Wild.AI app for current users across iOS and Android Maintain compatibility with third-party wearables such as Apple Watch and Garmin Begin global rollout of Wild.AI features across Amazfit devices, starting in the United States Deepen its focus on hormone-informed coaching and wellness across all stages of a woman’s life ‍ The Wild.AI app will remain available for non-Amazfit users, and all existing services will continue uninterrupted. ‍ About Amazfit Amazfit, a leading global smart wearable brand focused on health and fitness, is part of Zepp Health (NYSE: ZEPP), a health technology company with its principal office based in Gorinchem, the Netherlands. Zepp Health operates as a distributed organization, with team members and offices across the Americas, Europe, Asia, and other global markets. ‍ Offering a wde selection of smartwatches and bands, Amazfit's brand tagline, “Discover Amazing,” encourages individuals to break barriers, exceed expectations, and find joy in every moment. Amazfit is powered by Zepp Health’s proprietary health management platform, which delivers cloud-based, 24/7 actionable insights and guidance to help users achieve their wellness goals. ‍ Known for outstanding craftsmanship, Amazfit smartwatches have won numerous design awards, including the iF Design Award and the Red Dot Design Award. Launched in 2015, Amazfit is embraced by millions of users, with products available in over 90 countries across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions. For more information, visit www.amazfit.com . ‍ About Wild.AI Wild.AI helps women turn their hormones into their superpower through an ecosystem of groundbreaking products. Their flagship product, the Wild.AI app, is dedicated to helping women enhance their fitness and sports performance through insights tailored to the main milestones in a woman's life - menstrual cycle (including 148 birth controls), perimenopause, and menopause. The app, backed by 450 whitepapers, offers practical training, nutrition, and recovery advice to optimize health and fitness outcomes. Wild.AI also offers a comprehensive suite of additional tools, including a coaching dashboard, a coaching academy, and a supplement store designed to enhance women's health and performance. ‍ Contacts Media Contact Mary Woodbury Head of Public Relations, Amazfit North America mary.woodbury@zepp.com

title: The Board of Directors of TotalEnergies confirms the relevance and progress of the Company’s strategy, as the differentiated and profitably growing energy major
summary: The Board of Directors confirms the priority given to dividend growth through cycles and decides to adjust the pace of share buybacks to energy environment in order to face economic and geopolitical uncertainties and to retain room to maneuver. The Board of Directors approves the 2026 capital increase reserved for employees that will bring employee shareholding […]
body_text: The Board of Directors confirms the priority given to dividend growth through cycles and decides to adjust the pace of share buybacks to energy environment in order to face economic and geopolitical uncertainties and to retain room to maneuver. The Board of Directors approves the 2026 capital increase reserved for employees that will bring employee shareholding to more than 9% of the Company's share capital. The Board of Directors also approves the technical project to convert ADRs (American Depositary Receipts) listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 1991 into ordinary shares. Paris, September 24, 2025 – During its annual strategic seminar held on September 23 & 24, 2025 and its meeting on September 24, 2025, the Board of Directors of TotalEnergies reviewed the Company's 2030 strategic outlook that will be presented to investors on September 29. The Board of Directors confirmed the relevance of the Company’s profitable growth transition strategy that is anchored on two pillars: oil and gas, mainly LNG, and Integrated Power. The Board of Directors is pleased by the progress of multiple projects that will contribute to the Company’s overall energy production (oil, gas, electricity) growth objective of 4% per year through 2030, while reducing emissions from its operations. In this context, the Board of Directors is pleased with the award of the offshore wind project "Centre Manche 2" to TotalEnergies, as the operator, materializing the Company's transition strategy in France. Thanks to a clear and disciplined investment framework, the update of which will be presented on September 29, alongside strong cash flow growth during 2025-2030, the Board of Directors confirmed its commitment to deliver an attractive shareholder return policy while preserving balance sheet strength. The Board of Directors therefore confirmed the shareholder return policy of at least 40% of annual cash flow from operations through cycles and reaffirmed the dividend as a priority in a low cycle environment. TotalEnergies’ dividend has grown more than 20% over the last three years and it has not been cut in 40 years. The Board of Directors also confirmed the priority given to preserving a strong balance sheet and retaining maneuverability by maintaining a gearing ratio below 20% in an uncertain economic and geopolitical environment. Therefore, the Board of Directors has decided to adjust the pace of share buybacks to hydrocarbon prices, refining and petrochemical margins and the $/€ exchange rate. Considering the current environment, the Board of Directors has authorized $1.5 billion of share buybacks in the fourth quarter 2025, resulting in $7.5 billion of share buybacks for the full year 2025. In addition, the Board of Directors has approved for 2026 share buyback guidance of between $0.75 billion and $1.5 billion per quarter for a Brent price between $60 and $70/b and an exchange rate around 1.20 $/€. The Board of Directors also approved the terms for the 2026 capital increase reserved for employees. It was delighted by the strong participation of employees, with employee shareholding reaching 8.9% of Company’s share capital in 2025 - an increase of more than 50% over the past ten years - making it #1 in employee shareholding in Europe in terms of capitalization held. Finally, the Board of Directors also approved the technical project to convert the ADRs (American Depositary Receipts) that have been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 1991 into ordinary shares. This operation will have no impact on holders of ordinary shares listed on Euronext Paris, which will remain the introduction’s market for TotalEnergies shares. ***

title: How Safe Spaces Are Changing the Way Women Heal, Connect, and Thrive
summary: Support groups for women are doing more than offering a place to vent. They’re reshaping how we talk about mental health, how we show up for each other, and how we reclaim our well-being on our own terms.
body_text: Something powerful happens when women sit in a circle whether in a room or on a Zoom call and start speaking from the heart. Walls come down. Stories come out. And slowly, healing begins. Support groups for women are doing more than offering a place to vent. They’re reshaping how we talk about mental health, how we show up for each other, and how we reclaim our well-being on our own terms. These aren’t therapy substitutes or one-size-fits-all solutions. They’re judgment-free spaces built on empathy, shared wisdom, and honest conversation. In these groups, anxiety doesn’t mean weakness, and depression isn’t hidden in shame. Everything is valid. Everything belongs. Let’s dive into what makes these support circles so transformative and how they’re helping women everywhere feel seen, heard, and stronger than ever. What Makes a Women’s Support Group Different? It’s not just a place to talk it’s a space where women can breathe. A support group for women is designed to feel safe. Members bring their truths without fear of judgment. Some are peer-led. Others are guided by licensed facilitators. Many are focused on specific life experiences like postpartum struggles, burnout, or past trauma. What they all have in common: real connection, real respect, and a commitment to showing up for each other. These spaces often become the bridge between professional therapy and everyday emotional survival. How Do Support Groups Help Women Navigate Mental Health Challenges? They help women stop carrying everything alone. Within a group, that heavy weight of anxiety or trauma starts to feel more manageable. You hear someone else share something that mirrors your experience, and suddenly you don’t feel quite so alone. You pick up stress-reduction tips. You learn about grounding techniques. You hear how another mom is juggling parenting and panic attacks and you nod, knowing exactly what that feels like. Support groups are part emotional release, part learning space, and part lifeline. The healing is mutual and collective. Which Mental Health Conditions Do Women’s Groups Often Address? Women’s support groups speak directly to the things society still whispers about. Common focuses include: Anxiety and panic disorders Depression and mood imbalances Bipolar disorder Postpartum and perinatal mental health PTSD and trauma recovery Eating disorders Hormonal and menopause-related emotional shifts Some also offer space for women facing domestic violence, sexual assault, or identity-based challenges like racism or homophobia. The goal is to meet women where they are—and honor the full spectrum of what they’re carrying. What’s Changing in the Way Women Talk About Mental Health? Today’s support groups are more inclusive, more intentional, and more culturally aware. No more watered-down, one-size-fits-all advice. Many groups now center specific communities: women of color, LGBTQ+ women, mothers, survivors. The focus is on authentic, relevant conversation not generic mental health talk. That shift is changing everything. Women are speaking more boldly, asking better questions, and finding language that fits their lived experience not someone else’s idea of healing. Why Are Anxiety Groups a Lifesaver for So Many Women? Anxiety doesn’t always look like a panic attack. Sometimes it’s sleepless nights, racing thoughts, or that constant edge-of-burnout feeling. Support groups help by normalizing those feelings and offering practical tools to manage them breathwork, journaling prompts, self-regulation exercises. They also create space to talk through what’s really underneath the anxiety, with people who won’t minimize or dismiss it. How Do Depression Groups Help Women Reconnect With Hope? Depression can make even simple tasks feel impossible. But being in a room or on a screen with others who get it can break through that fog. These groups remind you that your struggle is real, and that recovery doesn’t have to happen in isolation. From goal-setting to gratitude practices to simply being witnessed, these sessions rebuild hope one shared story at a time. Why Representation Matters: Groups for Women of Color and LGBTQ+ Women Healing hits differently when you don’t have to explain your identity before you can talk about your pain. Culturally specific groups offer validation without caveats. Whether it's racial trauma, gender identity struggles, or navigating microaggressions at work, these groups meet women at the intersection of their truth and their trauma. It’s not just about mental health it’s about belonging. Why Moms Desperately Need These Spaces Motherhood can be beautiful. It can also be isolating, exhausting, and emotionally overwhelming. Support groups for moms offer a place to say the hard things without guilt. Whether it's postpartum anxiety, managing a career while parenting, or navigating identity loss, these spaces give mothers the tools and support to care for themselves while caring for others. What Do Women Gain From Joining a Support Group? Here’s what really happens when you join a group: You stop feeling alone. You learn how to cope better. You rebuild self-esteem. You connect with resources you didn’t even know existed. You grow emotionally, mentally, and sometimes spiritually. The longer you show up, the more your resilience grows. And over time, that group becomes more than a meeting it becomes your circle of strength. How Do Support Groups Reduce Loneliness? Showing up to a group virtually or in-person reminds you that someone is there. Someone is listening. That ongoing connection reduces isolation and fosters genuine friendships. You’re no longer the only one navigating your emotions. You’re part of a collective journey, and that changes everything. How Does Peer Support Lead to Real Growth? There’s something powerful about advice from someone who’s been there. Peer-led groups offer lived experience, not just textbook knowledge. Members swap real-life solutions, share encouragement, and hold each other accountable in ways that feel accessible and affirming. How to Find the Right Group for You Don’t rush it. Explore your options and trust your gut. Start by asking yourself: What do I need help with right now? Do I prefer a peer-led or professionally facilitated group? Would I feel more comfortable in an identity-specific space? Do I want something local or online? Then search online, ask your therapist or doctor, or check directories through mental health organizations. Many groups offer trial sessions so you can see if it feels like the right fit. What Can You Expect at a Support Group Meeting? You’ll typically be welcomed by a facilitator who sets the tone and reviews ground rules (confidentiality is always key). From there, members may take turns sharing, or the session might follow a specific theme. Some groups include grounding activities or breakout discussions. Others leave space for whatever needs to be said that day. You don’t have to speak until you’re ready. Just being there matters. Are Online Support Groups Just as Effective? Yes, especially if in-person options aren’t accessible. Online groups offer flexibility, privacy, and a wider variety of focus areas. They’re perfect for busy schedules, rural locations, or anyone who feels safer opening up from home. That said, if you thrive on face-to-face energy, in-person groups might feel more grounding. Both formats are valid. Choose what works best for you. How to Get Involved Today Start small. Choose one group. Try one session. Whether it’s through a local nonprofit, an online directory, or a recommendation from a friend, take that first step. You don’t have to commit forever just be curious enough to explore. From emotional relief to long-term growth, the benefits start the moment you show up. Free vs. Paid Groups: What’s the Difference? Free groups (often through nonprofits or clinics) offer accessibility and community. Premium or private groups may provide smaller settings, specific topics, or extra resources like workbooks or coaching. If budget is tight, start with free options. Many are excellent and run by deeply committed facilitators. Where Can You Share and Be Heard? Online platforms like MentalHappy.com Facebook groups or private forums Community centers and wellness hubs Faith-based or cultural organizations Women-led nonprofits focused on mental health Your voice matters and there’s a space for it. Final Thoughts: Women Supporting Women Is Mental Health Care Support groups aren’t a backup plan. They’re a powerful, necessary form of care. They create space for vulnerability, resilience, and connection. They reduce stigma and silence. And they remind every woman that her story isn’t too messy, too small, or too complicated to be heard. In these spaces, healing happens out loud and together. 💬 Ready to find your circle? Visit MentalHappy.com to explore supportive communities built for women because mental wellness starts with being seen, supported, and surrounded by those who get it. ‍

title: AC Pro Keeps HVAC projects moving in Los Angeles with Curri
summary: See how AC Pro in Fontana uses Curri Hotshots to cover urgent HVAC deliveries across Los Angeles and Southern California, keeping customers on schedule.
body_text: At AC Pro, an HVAC distributor headquartered in Fontana, California, mornings start before dawn. Steve Cobb, who oversees supply for 36 locations across Southern California, is at his desk by 3:45 a.m. His drivers are rolling by 4:00 a.m., and by the time AC Pro branches open at 6:00, they expect to have material ready for contractors who count on same-day service. “It’s early mornings and tight deadlines,” Steve says. “My job is to make sure our locations and residential new construction customers have the product they need to repair, install, and develop HVAC systems. Customer service has to be on point every morning.” With 15 drivers covering Southern California routes, AC Pro’s fleet is busy—and sometimes stretched too thin. That’s when Steve turns to Curri. “If I have a driver call off, or if a location sells so much that the material won’t fit on the truck, I use Curri to back up my fleet,” he explains. A Safety Net for Southern California Deliveries AC Pro has grown into one of the largest HVAC distributors in the region, with additional branches in Nevada, Utah, and Arizona. But in Los Angeles and across Southern California, the logistics challenge is especially intense. ACPro, an HVAC distributor headquartered in Fontana, CA Steve relies on Curri in two key situations: Overflow orders – When sales at a branch exceed truck capacity, Curri picks up the slack. Driver shortages – When one of the 15 drivers calls off, Curri fills in to keep routes covered. That flexibility means contractors don’t face delays and AC Pro locations open fully stocked. “One morning a driver called me at 3:45 a.m. to say he couldn’t make it,” Steve recalls. “I booked a Curri right away. The driver was just 10 minutes away and left our branch at 4:05—only five minutes late. We still made it on time before the location opened. That saved the day.” Why AC Pro Relies on Curri Steve has used other couriers in the past, but Curri quickly became his go-to because of the platform. “I used to have to wait until six or seven in the morning to call a courier,” he says. “With Curri, I can book a truck at 4 a.m. online. I don’t have to talk to anybody. It’s faster and easier.” The features he values most include: Fast booking – Orders scheduled in minutes, no phone calls required. Live tracking – Steve keeps a Curri window open on his computer all day. “If a customer calls, I can look and tell them exactly where the driver is.” Proof of delivery – Photos and signatures confirm jobs are done right. Vehicle fit – For HVAC deliveries, Steve often books 26’ box trucks with liftgates. “Most of our locations don’t have docks, so that liftgate is crucial.” Responsive support – “If I need to reroute or adjust, the customer service team helps me out tremendously.” Curri’s on-demand fleet isn’t just convenient—it’s become essential. Real-World Impact Every day brings new challenges in the HVAC supply business. From overflow pallets to last-minute changes, Steve has seen Curri help AC Pro handle it all. “I like the fact that I can put in a request, have an answer within five minutes, and know the driver is en route,” he says. “That peace of mind matters when I’ve got 36 locations counting on me.” The result is smoother operations and better service for contractors across Southern California. “It allows us to do more runs than we normally would. That has definitely impacted sales in a positive way.” Consistency That Builds Trust While most Curri drivers meet Steve’s standards, he’s not shy about providing feedback. “If I see something off, like a driver not dressed appropriately, I report it. And the Curri team takes care of it immediately. That responsiveness has been a pleasure to work with.” For Steve, consistency is key. When contractors receive materials on time, their crews stay productive and AC Pro strengthens its reputation as a reliable partner. A Platform That Works the Way He Works Steve keeps Curri open all day on his desktop, monitoring multiple trucks at once. “If I have three trucks going out, I have three Curri windows open,” he says. “I can track them in real time. A lot of customers don’t pay attention to the emails they get for tracking, so they call me directly. I like being able to say, ‘Your driver is 10 minutes away.’” It’s a level of visibility he didn’t have with other couriers. “Personally, I love tracking deliveries as a consumer too,” he adds. “Seeing your number in line, watching the truck move—it’s a great feature.” Why Curri Stands Out Steve describes Curri in simple terms: “Curri is like Uber for truckloads,” he says. “It’s a helpful resource for customer service–related delivery issues.” He recommends the platform to peers in the industry, and many of AC Pro’s other branches—including Bloomington, Riverside, Santa Ana, Escondido, and Chatsworth—now use Curri as well. “Some of our branches use Curri for smaller vehicles like pickup trucks and cars, especially for miscellaneous parts. Others book box trucks like I do. But everybody sees the value.” Looking Ahead For Steve, the ability to request preferred drivers will make Curri even more valuable. “There are a few drivers I’d prefer to keep on my list,” he says. “That feature is going to be amazing.” He also sees Curri’s responsiveness as a reason to keep building the relationship. “I’ve made suggestions before, and the team has listened. That matters.” From Fontana to Los Angeles and across Southern California, AC Pro counts on Curri to keep HVAC projects moving. Whether it’s covering a last-minute driver call-out or hauling overflow orders to busy branches, Curri gives AC Pro the flexibility to deliver on its promises. “Curri has definitely impacted our sales in the right direction,” Steve says. “It lets us do more runs than we normally could, and that keeps our customers happy.” Ready to keep your projects moving like AC Pro? title: 24x7 Magazine: Axel Wirth on Legacy Devices and Hospital Cybersecurity Risks
summary: 24x7 Magazine interviews Medcrypt’s Axel Wirth on the cybersecurity dangers of legacy medical devices and the urgent need for proactive hospital risk management.
body_text: In a recent 24x7 Magazine feature by Alyx Arnett , Medcrypt’s Chief Security Strategist Axel Wirth sheds light on one of healthcare’s most persistent security challenges: legacy medical devices . These systems, often running on unsupported or outdated operating systems, represent a significant vulnerability within hospital networks. Axel explains that the most serious consequence of these vulnerabilities isn’t just data loss — it’s patient harm. He urges health systems to take immediate steps to inventory connected assets, segment networks, and demand accountability from vendors , emphasizing that waiting for a cyberattack or regulatory action is not a viable strategy. This piece builds on Medcrypt’s ongoing advocacy for secure device design and lifecycle management, positioning the company as a trusted authority in medical device cybersecurity and a partner to healthcare leaders working to modernize clinical infrastructure. Read the full article: Legacy Medical Devices Pose Major Cybersecurity Risks – 24x7 Magazine ‍

title: Step into London's Legendary Blitz Club with Snap AR
summary: Snapchat brings London's famous Blitz Club to life with museum augmented reality experience
body_text: Snapchat's AR Studio Paris has partnered with the Design Museum for the launch of the museum's latest exhibition on the history of the London night club Blitz where the culture of the 1980s began. London’s 1980s club scene was a revolution in style, and the Blitz Club stood at its center. As part of the museum’s exhibition, visitors can unlock an immersive AR experience that transports them to a Tuesday night at the club. The entrance of the Design Museum will recreate the famous door policy of the club - where only the most creative, stylish, and flamboyant looks were allowed entry. Visitors will be able to use Snap's technology to virtually try on daring high-fashion looks once worn by the Blitz Kids — a generation that redefined fashion, music, art, and culture. The spirit of the Blitz lives on, giving today’s audiences a chance to step into one of London’s most influential cultural moments. The exhibition opens from 20 September 2025 - 29 March 2026. “ We're kicking off September fashion month in style - working again with our friends at the Design Museum to bring to life one of the most iconic moments for fashion and culture in the capital. We're excited to throw it back to a Tuesday night in the 80s through Snapchat's technology, right in the heart of central London at the legendary club, Blitz. From virtually trying on high fashion that inspired global superstars, to theatrical makeup and daring punk looks from this era - we can't wait to see visitors to the Blitz exhibition walk through the exclusive club's doors and immerse themselves in the era of the ultimate trendsetters. Ben Wymer, Senior Director Global Brand Experience and AR Studio Paris

title: Construction Budget Template : Free Download (Editable)
summary: Use our construction budget template to easily plan, track, and manage your project costs. Free Download Construction Budget Template (Editable)
body_text: What is a construction budget template? A construction budget template is a ready-to-use format that helps organize and manage all the costs involved in a construction project. Instead of building a budget from scratch, this template provides a structured layout where you can fill in cost estimates, actual expenses, and keep track of how much money has been spent in each area of the project. By using a template, project managers and contractors can make sure that every cost is listed and accounted for – nothing gets missed. This helps in avoiding budget overruns and allows for better decision-making during the project. What is a construction budget? A construction budget is a detailed plan that outlines all the expected costs of a construction project. It includes everything from material and labor costs to permits, equipment, overhead, and even unexpected expenses. The main purpose of a construction budget is to make sure the project stays within financial limits while meeting deadlines and quality standards. Creating a budget is one of the most important steps in the planning phase of any construction job. Whether it’s a small house renovation or a large commercial building, having a clear budget helps avoid surprises and delays. It also makes communication easier between the client, contractor, and project team, as everyone understands how money will be spent. A well-prepared construction budget provides: A clear breakdown of all costs Estimated timelines for each stage of spending Allocation for contingency (extra funds for unexpected costs) A basis for tracking expenses during the project Without a solid budget, it becomes very easy to overspend or mismanage resources, which can lead to project failure. Who is this construction budget template for? This construction budget template is meant for anyone responsible for organizing or overseeing the financial aspects of a construction project. It can be used by: Contractors who need to keep track of job costs and stay within client budgets. Project managers looking for a transparent breakdown of spending across all stages of the project. Builders and developers handling residential, commercial, or industrial construction work can benefit from using this tool. Site engineers who are responsible for monitoring daily or weekly expenses. Homeowners taking on a self-managed renovation or new home build. Small construction firms or startups looking for a simple way to manage costs without using expensive software. In short, this template is for anyone who wants to control costs, avoid surprises, and complete their construction work within budget. When should you use this construction budget template? You should use this template at the very beginning of your project – during the planning stage. It helps you prepare a clear estimate of how much money will be needed and where it will go. You can also use it throughout the project to: Track spending in real-time Compare actual costs with planned costs Update estimates when there are changes in material prices or work scope Make decisions faster based on financial data Communicate with clients or stakeholders by showing them organized, updated cost reports Whether it’s a new build, a renovation, or a large-scale commercial project, this template helps you stay financially in control from start to finish. Why use a construction budget template? Managing a construction project involves handling multiple expenses – materials, labor, permits, equipment, subcontractors, and more. Without a structured system in place, it’s easy to lose track of these costs, overspend, or run into delays. This is why having a construction budget template becomes so important. Using a construction budget template helps you: Stay organized: It puts all your project expenses in one place, broken down into clear categories. Track costs easily: You can compare estimated costs with actual spending as the project moves forward. Avoid budget overruns: Early warnings about overspending help you adjust quickly. Make better decisions: A clear overview of your finances supports smarter planning and faster approvals. Save time: With pre-built formulas and fields, there’s no need to build your budget from scratch. Improve client communication: Share regular updates on budget status with clients or stakeholders using a clear, professional format. No matter if it’s a minor home renovation or a large-scale commercial build, this template helps maintain control and reduce unexpected costs. How to use this construction budget template for excel This construction budget template is designed to work easily in Excel, so you can customize it based on your project needs. Follow this simple step-by-step guide to start using the template effectively: 1. Download and Open the Template Begin by downloading the Excel file and opening it on your computer. You’ll see pre-filled columns and headings designed for construction budgeting. 2. Review the Categories The template comes pre-filled with key cost categories such as labor, materials, equipment, permits, overhead, and contingency. Review these sections to ensure they fit your project’s needs. Feel free to customize the list by adding or removing categories based on the type and size of your work. 3. Enter Estimated Costs Under each category, fill in your estimated cost for that task or item. This helps you plan your total project budget before work begins. 4. Track Actual Expenses As your construction project moves forward, regularly fill in the “Actual Cost” column with the most up-to-date figures. This allows you to compare your original estimates with what you’ve actually spent. 5. Monitor the Difference The built-in formulas in the sheet will automatically compare estimated and actual expenses, allowing you to quickly identify any budget overruns and make adjustments to keep spending under control. 6. Update and Share Keep the template updated throughout the project. It becomes a helpful tool not only for internal tracking but also for sharing with clients or team members who want to stay informed. FAQs 1. What is a construction budget template? A construction budget template is a ready-made spreadsheet that helps you plan, organize, and track all expenses related to a construction project, including labor, materials, permits, and more. 2. Who should use a construction budget template? Contractors, project managers, homeowners, builders, and anyone managing a construction project can use this template to stay on top of their costs and avoid overspending. 3. Can I customize the construction budget template? Yes, can be easily customized to match your project size, category breakdown, or reporting needs. 4. How does a construction budget template help in project tracking? It lets you compare estimated and actual costs in real-time, identify budget overruns early, and make informed decisions to keep the project financially on track. 5. Is the template only useful for large projects? No, it works well for both small residential tasks and large commercial projects. You can scale it up or down based on your requirements. 6. How often should I update the budget template? Ideally, you should update it every time you spend money or receive a bill. Regular updates give you a clear picture of your current financial status.

title: Convenio de Hostelería de la Las Palmas 2025
summary: Conoce las claves del Convenio Colectivo de Hostelería de la Provincia de Las Palmas, que marca la pauta laboral en un sector vital para las islas.
body_text: Puntos clave del convenio Vigencia prolongada: El convenio regula el sector desde el 1 de enero de 2020 hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2025 , proporcionando un marco de estabilidad a largo plazo. Ajuste salarial para 2025: Las tablas salariales para el último año de vigencia (2025) incluyen una subida pactada del 2% sobre las de 2024. Jornada y Descanso: Establece una jornada máxima anual con regulación específica de descansos, vacaciones y contratación para el turismo de temporada. Jornada ordinaria: 40 h/semana (cómputo anual de horas efectivas). Salarios: subidas pactadas cada año a partir de 2022 y reglas claras para extras, nocturnidad y festivos. Introducción clara sobre el convenio El Convenio Colectivo de Hostelería de la Provincia de Las Palmas y sus Municipios (2020-2025) es la herramienta jurídica que define los derechos y obligaciones de miles de profesionales y empresas que forman parte del motor económico de la provincia. Negociado entre las organizaciones empresariales y sindicales más representativas, este texto es fundamental no solo para fijar un marco de condiciones justas, sino también para dotar de estabilidad y certidumbre al sector en una zona de alta dependencia del turismo. Su larga vigencia, hasta finales de 2025, es una prueba del compromiso por asegurar unas bases laborales sólidas. Contexto y Ámbito de Aplicación del convenio de hostelería Este convenio es de ámbito provincial y se aplica a todas las empresas y personas trabajadoras que desarrollen actividades de hostelería en la provincia de Las Palmas, incluyendo las islas de Gran Canaria, Fuerteventura y Lanzarote . Abarca, sin excepción, a: Hoteles y Alojamientos Turísticos: Hoteles, apartahoteles, apartamentos turísticos, etc. Restauración: Restaurantes, bares, cafeterías, pubs, y similares. Catering y Colectividades: Empresas que prestan servicios de comidas en eventos o centros. Su aplicación es obligatoria y prevalece sobre cualquier acuerdo de empresa que establezca condiciones menos favorables para la plantilla. Nota: Este convenio no aplica a Tenerife, que tiene su propio convenio. Condiciones Generales del convenio ¿Qué jornada laboral establece el convenio de hostelería de Las Palmas? El convenio establece una jornada máxima anual de 1.782 horas de trabajo efectivo . Jornada Semanal: Se mantiene en un máximo de 40 horas semanales de promedio. Descanso Semanal: Se garantiza un mínimo de dos días de descanso ininterrumpido a la semana, fomentando la conciliación y el bienestar. Vacaciones: El personal tiene derecho a 30 días naturales de vacaciones al año, de los cuales al menos 15 deben disfrutarse de forma continuada en temporada estival. Contratación: Dada la estacionalidad del turismo canario, el convenio pone especial énfasis en la regulación de los contratos fijos-discontinuos , detallando los criterios de llamamiento y el tiempo mínimo de inactividad, aportando seguridad jurídica tanto a la empresa como a la persona trabajadora. ¿Qué salario establece el convenio de hostelería de Las Palmas? El salario es uno de los puntos clave de este convenio, especialmente en su tramo final de vigencia. Las retribuciones para 2025 se consolidan tras los incrementos pactados en la última revisión: Incremento Salarial 2025: Se aplica un aumento del 2% sobre las tablas vigentes de 2024. Complementos: Además del salario base, se regulan complementos por antigüedad (consolidable), nocturnidad y trabajo en días festivos . Pagas Extraordinarias: Se establecen tres pagas extraordinarias anuales (Verano, Navidad y Beneficios), calculadas según el salario base y el complemento de antigüedad. Desarrollo de las novedades principales La principal novedad del tramo final de vigencia del Convenio de Las Palmas es la consolidación de las mejoras salariales. El incremento del 2% para 2025 busca mantener el poder adquisitivo de la plantilla ante la inflación y asegurar una base retributiva competitiva en la provincia. Subrogación de contratos Aunque es una práctica habitual en otros convenios, el de Las Palmas detalla las condiciones de subrogación en los casos de cambio de titularidad de la empresa. Esto garantiza que la plantilla mantenga sus derechos y condiciones laborales al cambiar el operador del negocio (hoteles o grandes restaurantes), aportando una gran seguridad laboral . Formación Profesional Dual El convenio promueve activamente la Formación Profesional Dual para incorporar nuevo talento al sector, reconociendo la figura del contrato formativo con condiciones específicas de retribución y un compromiso de mejora profesional al finalizar el periodo de aprendizaje. A continuación, se muestra una tabla con el salario base mensual estimado para las principales categorías, aplicando el incremento del 2% para el ejercicio 2025. Nota: Estos valores son representativos y deben confirmarse siempre con el documento oficial del convenio. Preguntas frecuentes sobre el Convenio de Hostelería de Las Palmas ¿Hasta cuándo está vigente el Convenio de Hostelería de Las Palmas? El convenio está vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2020 hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2025 . Una vez finalizada su vigencia, se prorrogará anualmente hasta la firma de un nuevo acuerdo. ¿Cómo se aplica el incremento salarial del 2% en 2025? El incremento del 2% se aplica sobre los salarios base y demás conceptos retributivos de las tablas salariales de 2024, con efecto desde el 1 de enero de 2025. ¿Qué ocurre con las personas con contrato fijo-discontinuo? El convenio protege al personal fijo-discontinuo, estableciendo la obligación de llamamiento según el orden de antigüedad en cada categoría o puesto. También detalla que el periodo de inactividad debe ser coherente con la actividad estacional. ¿Cuántas pagas extras se cobran con este convenio? Se establecen tres pagas extraordinarias: Verano, Navidad y una paga de Beneficios, sumando un total de 15 pagas anuales. ¿A quién aplica este convenio? A todas las empresas y personas trabajadoras del sector de hostelería en la provincia de Las Palmas, según las categorías profesionales del convenio. ¿Cuál es la jornada y los descansos? La jornada ordinaria es de 40 h/semana. Debe respetarse un descanso mínimo de 12 h entre jornadas y dos días consecutivos de descanso semanal. ¿Cómo se retribuyen nocturnidad, festivos y eventos? El convenio fija recargos específicos para horas en tramo nocturno, trabajo en festivo y servicios especiales (banquetes, bodas, etc.). ¿Se pueden hacer horas extra? Con carácter general están suprimidas. Si concurren causas justificadas, tienen topes y recargos definidos. ‍ Digitaliza la Gestión Laboral en Hostelería Para cumplir con las condiciones del convenio, especialmente en lo referente a la gestión de costes salariales , es fundamental tener una herramienta que te ayude a mantener las cuentas claras. En un sector con márgenes ajustados como la hostelería, haddock te ayuda a: Digitalizar facturas y albaranes de forma automática. Controlar los costes de ingredientes y materias primas en tiempo real. Optimizar la gestión de pedidos y el escandallo para asegurar la rentabilidad . Controlar tus costes con precisión es la mejor manera de asegurar que tu negocio no solo cumple con el convenio, sino que también maximiza su rentabilidad. ‍ × ¡Espera un momento! ¿Seguro que quieres irte sin probar una demo de haddock.app?
